SYMFLUENCE - Hydrological Modeling Framework

positional arguments:
  <category>            Command category
    workflow            Workflow execution and management
    project             Project initialization and setup
    binary              External tool management and pass-through execution
    config              Configuration management
    job                 SLURM job submission
    example             Example notebooks
    agent               AI agent interface
    gui                 Graphical user interface
    tui                 Interactive terminal user interface
    data                Standalone data acquisition
    doctor              Run system diagnostics
    fews                Delft-FEWS adapter operations

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG       Path to configuration file (default: ./config.yaml)
  --debug               Enable debug output
  --visualise, --visualize
                        Enable visualization during execution
  --diagnostic          Enable diagnostic plots for workflow validation
  --dry-run             Show what would be executed without running
  --profile             Enable I/O profiling to diagnose IOPS bottlenecks
  --profile-output PROFILE_OUTPUT
                        Path for profiling report output (default:
                        profile_report.json)
  --profile-stacks      Capture stack traces in profiling (expensive, for
                        debugging)
  --version             show program's version number and exit

Examples:
  symfluence workflow run --config my_config.yaml
  symfluence workflow step calibrate_model
  symfluence project init fuse-provo --scaffold
  symfluence binary install summa mizuroute
  symfluence doctor
  symfluence project pour-point 51.1722/-115.5717 --domain-name Bow --definition delineate

For more help on a specific command:
  symfluence <category> --help
  symfluence <category> <action> --help
